title: National Silent E Day and the small things that change a word
dek: Today is National Silent E Day, a playful reminder of how one quiet letter turns hop into hope.
body: Today is National Silent E Day, which might be the most gentle holiday on the calendar. It celebrates the letter e at the end of words, the one we do not say but that changes everything before it.

Anyone who has helped a child learn to read knows about this letter. Add an e to hop and you get hope. Add one to cap and you get cape. Kid becomes kite. The e makes no sound of its own, but it changes how the whole word sounds.
I like that as an idea for people, too. Some of the most important people in our lives are quiet ones. They do not take up much space in the room, but they change how everything around them feels.
It is also a fun thing to share at bedtime. If you have kids learning to read, turning words into new words by adding an e can feel like a magic trick to them.
Tonight, try the silent e game with someone at home, or send a thank you to one quiet person who makes your days better.
